title: hive-pool export-legacy: request body
description: Renders Pool items in the legacy Markdown format and returns the text. It writes no file: the caller decides where the text goes. With a migration, an item unmodified since its import, meaning the item at its imported revision and the holds on it exactly the holds the import placed, each at its imported revision, is emitted from its exact original lines and a modified item is re-rendered canonically; the free-form lines, preamble and section order of the source are kept, and every item is emitted in the section its current state maps to, a queued or in-flight item that has landed, a landed Target and a landed Prey with Hunts included, being read as done: an item whose state no longer maps to its source section moves to the end of the section of its present state. An archived item is not suppressed: archival has no form in the legacy format, so it is emitted in the section its state gives, and a blocker that never landed still blocks after a round trip. Read-only.

migration_id.description: Export the items of this migration in the source's order and form, each in the section of its current state. Without it, every item the selector matches is rendered canonically.

zone.description: The zone calendar dates are written in.

normalize.description: True: re-render every item canonically, as the legacy render verb does. Absent means false.
